# Acme Gateway

A product with digital elements, used here as the fixture that must stay silent.

## Manufacturer

Acme Digital BV, Keizersgracht 241, 1016 EA Amsterdam, Netherlands.
Electronic contact: info@acmegateway.nl

Single point of contact for vulnerability reports: security@acmegateway.nl

## Support period

Security updates and vulnerability handling are provided for this product until
the end of its support period on 2032-06-30. After that date no further security
updates are issued.

## Installing security updates

Security updates are distributed automatically through the package registry and
applied on restart. To install them manually run `npm update acme-gateway`. To
disable automatic updates set `ACME_AUTOUPDATE=0`; you then remain responsible
for applying each security patch yourself.

## Conformity

The EU declaration of conformity for this product is available at
https://acmegateway.nl/conformity/declaration.pdf
